a: Officially, November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It was delayed from a 2025 window, then from May 26, 2026, and Take-Two reiterated the November date in its November 2026 results.

q: What song is in the GTA 6 trailer?
a: Trailer 1 (December 2023) uses Tom Petty's 'Love Is a Long Road' and Trailer 2 (May 2025) uses The Pointer Sisters' 'Hot Together'. The October 15, 2026 Launch Trailer uses Justice's 'Flower in a Hurricane' with Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard.

q: Who is on the GTA 6 album?
a: Officially, as of November 15, 2026: Yung Lean with Future and Metro Boomin, Travis Scott, CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso with PinkPantheress, Fred again.. and Etienne de Crecy, Morgan Wallen, Rauw Alejandro, Keith Richards, and Justice with Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard. That is seven of 34 tracks; other names come from leaks.

q: Is the GTA 6 album tracklist leak real?
a: It is unconfirmed. A 34-track list shared on X on November 14, 2026, matches the seven official tracks and an October Spotify glitch, but the leaker is unnamed and neither Rockstar nor Atlantic has confirmed it.

q: What radio stations are in GTA 6?
a: Rockstar officially named six on October 8, 2026: Cocoteo FM, Back Country Radio, AfroBank FM, The Chamber 106.6, Flash FM and Dirty South Classics. Other names, such as CircoLoco Records Radio and V-Rock, come from leaked footage and are unconfirmed.

q: Does Lana Del Rey host a radio station in GTA 6?
a: Yes, officially. She hosts Back Country Radio as Delta Dawne alongside Morgan Wallen, announced October 8, 2026. A Lana Del Rey track on The Album appears only in the leaked tracklist.

q: Did the GTA 6 liquid vinyl sell out?
a: Yes, on September 17, 2026, the day it was announced, according to GTA Intel's check: the UK store sold out within minutes and the EU store that evening. It was priced at $124.98 on the official store.

q: How many pre-orders does GTA 6 have?
a: Take-Two has not released a number and only says pre-orders are at unprecedented levels. Sensor Tower estimated about 7.71 million digital pre-orders worth about $751 million in November 2026; that is an outside estimate that excludes physical copies.
